predecessors.name: Liao dynasty (Great Khitan State)
predecessors.text: the Kedun garrison, 'probably along the Orkhon River in Bulgan Province'

ledger.x: 1124: Yelü Dashi, fleeing the Jin conquest of the Liao, sets up his headquarters at the garrison of Kedun on the Orkhon.
1130: the Uyghur kingdom of Qocho submits to Dashi.
1130: Dashi leads his people west.
1134: Dashi takes Balasagun, the Kara-Khanid capital of the north.
1134: Balasagun becomes the capital.
1134: the Karluks of the Almaliq region become Dashi's vassals.
1137: Dashi defeats the Western Karakhanids at Khujand and takes the Fergana valley and Tashkent.
1139: Dzungaria is in Qara Khitai hands.
1141: the Kara-Khanids of Kashgar are Qara Khitai vassals.
1141: Dashi wins at Qatwan and the Kara-Khanids of Samarkand become his vassals.
1142: Khwarazm is made to pay tribute.
1147: the middle Syr Darya steppe is in Qara Khitai hands.
1152: 55,000 km2 of the Pamirs pass to the Lohara row.
1165: Balkh and Andkhud come under Qara Khitai rule through a vassal.
ledger.cp: Balkh vassal (the page does not name the holder)

ledger.x: 1198: Muhammad of Ghor seizes Balkh from the vassal.
ledger.cp: Balkh vassal (the page does not name the holder)

ledger.x: 1204: the Qara Khitai put down rebellions at Kashgar and Khotan.
1204: the rebellions are suppressed and the Kara-Khanids stay vassals.
1209: Qocho rebels and goes over to the Mongols.
1210: the Khwarezm-Shah takes Samarkand and defeats the Qara Khitai.
1210: Khwarazm throws off the tribute.
1210: the western edge of the direct land passes to Khwarazm.
1211: the Naiman Kuchlug seizes the throne.
1211: the Eastern Kara-Khanid prince is killed at Kashgar by rebels and the Eastern Khanate ends.
1211: the Karluk Arslan Khan surrenders to Genghis Khan.
1214: the Tarim rump passes to Kuchlug's Qara Khitai.
1216: Genghis Khan sends Jebe against Kuchlug.
1216: Samarkand, Fergana and Tashkent pass to Khwarazm.
1220: the Mongols finish the conquest.
1220: the Qara Khitai are absorbed into the Mongol Empire.

wars.name: Qara Khitai conquest of the Eastern Kara-Khanid lands
wars.outcome: Dashi is repelled at Kashgar in the summer of 1131, takes Balasagun in 1134 and, after 1137, Kashgar, Khotan and Beshbalik; the Kara-Khanids of Kashgar stay on as vassals.

wars.name: Qara Khitai conquest of the Fergana valley (Khujand)
wars.outcome: Dashi defeats the Western Karakhanids at Khujand in May 1137 and consolidates the Fergana valley and Tashkent.

wars.name: Qara Khitai attack on the Jin
wars.outcome: 'A disastrous attack on the Jin leads Dashi to give up recapturing northern China.'

wars.name: Battle of Qatwan
wars.outcome: Qara Khitai victory on 9 September 1141 north of Samarkand: 'a decisive defeat for the Seljuks'; Samarkand's khanate and Khwarazm become vassals.

wars.name: Qara Khitai-Khwarazm tribute wars
wars.outcome: Khwarazm pays 30,000 dinars a year from 1142; the Qara Khitai attack it in 1172 over neglected tribute and enthrone Tekish on 11 December 1172; tribute resumes in 1209-10; Muhammad II defeats the Qara Khitai near Talas and takes Samarkand in 1210.

wars.name: Qara Khitai-Ghurid war at Balkh
wars.outcome: Muhammad of Ghor seizes Balkh; the Qara Khitai invade at Kurzuban and lose 12,000 men.

wars.name: Kashgar and Khotan rebellions
wars.outcome: The rebellions at Kashgar and Khotan are put down.

wars.name: Mongol conquest of Qara Khitai
wars.outcome: Kuchlug, defeated by the Mongols in 1208, takes refuge with the Qara Khitai, usurps the throne in 1211, is pursued by Jebe from 1216 and is captured and killed in 1218; 'The Mongols fully conquered the former territories of the Qara-Khitai in 1220.'

certainty.note: Steppe, mountain and oasis frontiers throughout, no treaty line: the page gives the western border as the Amu Darya, the southern 'from Balkh to Khotan to Hami', the northern as the Yenisei Kyrgyz north of Lake Balkhash until 1175, and the…
